name: cypress-playwright-bdd-e2e
description: Testes E2E com BDD (Cucumber/Gherkin): os mesmos arquivos .feature executados no Cypress e no Playwright
author: Moisés Chiaretto

scripts.allure:cy:sem-falha: allure generate allure-results/cypress/01-sem-falha --clean --single-file -o allure-report/cypress/01-sem-falha --name Cypress-01-Sem-Falha && allure open allure-report/cypress/01-sem-falha
scripts.allure:cy:com-falha: allure generate allure-results/cypress/02-com-falha --clean --single-file -o allure-report/cypress/02-com-falha --name Cypress-02-Com-Falha && allure open allure-report/cypress/02-com-falha
scripts.allure:cy:indefinido: allure generate allure-results/cypress/03-indefinido --clean --single-file -o allure-report/cypress/03-indefinido --name Cypress-03-Indefinido && allure open allure-report/cypress/03-indefinido
scripts.allure:pw:sem-falha: allure generate allure-results/playwright/01-sem-falha --clean --single-file -o allure-report/playwright/01-sem-falha --name Playwright-01-Sem-Falha && allure open allure-report/playwright/01-sem-falha
scripts.allure:pw:com-falha: allure generate allure-results/playwright/02-com-falha --clean --single-file -o allure-report/playwright/02-com-falha --name Playwright-02-Com-Falha && allure open allure-report/playwright/02-com-falha
scripts.allure:pw:indefinido: allure generate allure-results/playwright/03-indefinido --clean --single-file -o allure-report/playwright/03-indefinido --name Playwright-03-Indefinido && allure open allure-report/playwright/03-indefinido
scripts.test:sem-falha: npm run cy:test:sem-falha && npm run pw:test:sem-falha
